 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled as ‘ Mall 35 ’ comprising of inter alia hotel apartments restaurants, and commercial shops located at Plot No. 35/A, Police Station Road, Rawalpindi (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and the F loor P lan of the Project and agrees to purchase the hotel apartment , as described in Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”) , along with leaseback to and buyback by the Developer with respect thereto ; and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and to take on lease or buy back the same from the Buyer, on the terms and conditions of this Agreement . 
 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the Purchase Price, the Developer will construct and sell rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “ Buyer ”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale , purchase and leaseback of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of this Agreement ( “Agreement” ) : 
 Description of Purchased Unit 
 This Agreement to Sell 
 General Terms and Conditions 
 Nominees 
 Leaseback Agreement, as may be renewed from time to time in ac cordance with the terms thereof 
 Attachment A : Payment Plan 
 Attachment B : Purchased Unit Floor Plan 
 Any other document forming part of this Agreement pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions , followed by the Payment Plan , and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming this Agreement . 
 
 
 
 BUYER ’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read and understood , and agrees to comply with this Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer , each such Buyer ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to this Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between t he Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement may be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below:

 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3. 2 of these General T erms and C onditions.

Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any U nit including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies , and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that do not form part of any given Unit.

 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date.

 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 1 2 .1 of these General T erms and C onditions.

 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 The Developer confirms that it has the necessary rights and title to the Project , to construct the Project and to sell the Purchased Unit and that it has received requisite approvals from Competent Authorities for the development and construction of the Project . Further, the Developer agrees to construct the Project and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, strictly in accordance with this Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 PA YMENT 
 
 The consideration for construction and payment of R ent of the Purchased Unit by t he Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Insta l ment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date along with any applicable Adjusted Amount such as to constitute the entire Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit , as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Attachment A of this Agreement ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable (if any) membership and other fees, taxes, levies, or any other charges whatsoever with respect to the sale , lease and buyback of the Purchased Unit, in accordance with law ; 
 
 The Buyer agreeing to abide by all Rules and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable to the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit shall remain fixed under this Agreement. However, the Purchase Price may be adjusted if, between the date of signing of this Agreement and the Completion date, there is an increase in the price of Component Material, as per the price indices published by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics insofar as applicable, or if there is an increase in applicable Taxes or any new Taxes. In this event, the Developer will make every reasonable effort for the Purchase Price to remain unaffected and ensure that any impact on the remaining Purchase Price is adjusted in a fair and reasonable manner (“ Adjusted Amount ”). 
 
 The adjustment in the Purchase Price under Clause 3. 2 shall be to the extent of increase in the price of Component Material and Taxes only, and the Buyer undertakes to pay the Adjusted Amount, which shall be deemed a part of the Payment Plan and the Purchase Price, at the time of possession upon completion of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment and/ or Adjusted Amount on its Du e Date or within thirty (30) days thereof , without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges , conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise howsoever , all of which shall be borne by the Buyer . Such payment shall be affected by one of the following means on or before the relevant Due Date , and the Buyer understands that failure to do so will be a breach of this Agreement , entitling the Developer to take such action as specified in Clause 11.1 : 
 
 By crossed cheque or bank draft in favour of “ Mall 35 ” ; 
 OR 
 With written notice to the Developer, by direct transfer or deposit into the account designated below , or such other designated bank account of the Developer as may be notified in writing :

 All Rules or any other regulations imposed by any association of owners or a Competent Authority in the present and in future will form a part of this Agreement . 
 
 CONSTRUCTION OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 It is agreed and understood by the Buyer that the Estimated Completion Date represents the date by which it is presently expected that the Project will be completed, and the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover to the Buyer, whereas the Completion Date represents the date by which the Project is completed and the Purchased Unit is ready for handover to the Buyer . 
 
 The Developer shall issue the Co mpletion Notice to the Buyer communicating the proposed Completion Date. The Completion Date shall be the date on which t he Purchased Unit shall be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer , provided that the Buyer has fulfilled its obligations under this Agreement and paid all Instalment Payments and any applicable Adjusted Amount under the Payment Plan . The Completion Date may be earlier or later than the Estimated Completion Date, in which case the Developer shall give one ( 1) month’s advance notice to the Buyer. In the event that the Completion Date is earlier than the Estimated Completion Date, the Buyer may postpone possession up to ( but no later than) the Estimated Completion Date. The I nstalment Payment and Adjusted Amount due on possession, as indicated in the Payment Plan , shall only be payable by the Buyer at the time of possession. Payment of R ent shall be subject to the Buyer having fully performed his/her obligations under this Agreement and clearing all the required payment(s), charges and taxes under provision s of this Agreement including the Buyer having completed all applicable formalities, payment of all fees, and charges etc. 
 
 Subject to Clause 4.2, the Buyer shall, within thirty (30) days of the Completion Date, clear any outstanding dues and payments under this Agreement . In the event the Buyer fails to make the relevant payments within said thirty (30) days, subject to Clause 4.2, the Buyer shall inter alia be responsible for such additional change(s) as the Developer deems fit. 
 
 TAXES 
 
 The Buyer shall pay all taxes pertaining to the purchase of the Purchased Unit and all related fees, costs, duties, and charges as may be required to effect the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit. To the extent any payment of any taxes or related fees are paid by the Developer on behalf of the Buyer (at the Developer’s discretion), the same shall be reimbursed by the Buyer prior to commencement of Rent . 
 
 LEASEBACK AND BUYBACK OF THE PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 On the Comple tion Date, subject to Clause 4 .2 , the Developer shall transfer the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and issue the allotment letter in favour of the Buyer, provided the Buyer has fulfilled its obligations under this Agreement (including without limitation payment of each Instalment Payment and any applicable Adjusted Amount) and other costs identified in this Agreement , or otherwise applicable and subject to execution of the Leaseback Agreement by the Buyer . The Developer shall not be obliged to transfer the Purchased Unit and provide the allotment letter where the Buyer is not in compliance with its obligations under this Agreement or has not executed the Leaseback Agreement . 
 In the event the Buyer sells the Purchased Unit to any other person (“ Third Party ”) in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , the sale and transfer to such Third Party shall be subject to prior issuance of NOC by the Developer, upon obtaining which, the Purchased Unit may be transferred from the Buyer to the Third Party, subject to applicable transfer charges. The Buyer undertakes that such Third Party shall be bound by the provisions of this Agreement , including inter alia the Leaseback Agreement , as and when applicable, and the Buyer shall procure that such Third Party does and executes all such acts, deeds and things as required under this Agreement including inter alia the Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 The Buyer shall execute all documents and do and cause to be done all such acts as may be required by the Developer with respect to the leaseback and buyback of the Purchased Unit under this Agreement to Sell . 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that this Agreement to Sell is subject to simultaneous leaseback of the Purchased Unit to the Developer whereby the Buyer transfers physical and vacant possession of the Purchased Unit to the Developer in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Leaseback Agreement , as well as buyback of the Purchased Unit by the Developer in accordance with these General Terms and Conditions . The Buyer understands and acknowledges that all rights, title, and interest in the Common areas and Common Facilities, roof and exterior walls shall always rest with the Developer . 
 
 All risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Purchased Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, in accordance with the Terms and Conditions of this Agreement . 
 
 Subject to Clause 6 . 3 above, the Buyer shall be eligible for receipt of Rent , in accordance with the terms of the Lease back Agreement , after clearance of any outstanding dues and payments and execution of any relevant undertakings and agreements by the Buyer . In the event the Buyer fails to make the relevant payments and provide undertakings as per this Clause 6 . 6 , it shall be considered an event of default as envisaged in Clause 11 of these General Terms and Conditio ns. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands , and accepts that the leaseback and buyback terms with respect to the Purchased Unit , subject to terms of the formal agreements in relation thereto, shall be as follows: 
 
 Leaseback Agreement shall be effective for a n initial lock-in period of ten (10 ) years starting from the Commencement Date which period is renewable for a further ten (10) years in accordance with the provisions of the Leaseback Agreement (“ Lease Period ”) ; 
 
 Payment of Rent shall commence six ( 6 ) months after the Estimated Completion Date, failing which monthly fee shall be paid by the Developer to the Buyer in accordance with Clause 10 of these General Terms and Conditions ; 
 
 Rent under the Leaseback Agreement shall be paid on a pro-rated basis calculated at seven percent ( 7% ) of the Purchase Price of the Pur chased Unit per annum , and shall increase by twenty-five percent (25% ) every three (3 ) years of the Lease Period; 
 
 In addition to payment of Rent to the Buyer , the Developer shall issue thirty ( 30 ) C omplimentary V ouchers to the Buyer as more fully described in and in accordance with the Leaseback Agreement ; 
 
 Upon lapse of the Lease Period, the Buyer shall either renew the Leaseback Agreement for a further period of ten ( 10 ) years as per the terms thereof or sell the Purchased Unit to the Developer at a price equal to 1.7 times the Purchase Price. 
 
 DEVELOPER ’S COVENANTS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 The Developer covenants or warrants as under: 
 
 T o carry out construction of the Project in compliance and to be built substantially in accordance with good building and engineering practice s , using suitable materials and in accordance with the requirements of concerned authorities , building codes, laws, rules and regulations currently in force. 
 
 To obtain manufacturers’ warranties in respect of any fixtures or fittings installed by or on behalf of the Developer in the Purchased Unit. The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty as regards the fitness for use or quality of appliances, fittings or fixtures and has relied on the manufacturers’/suppliers’ representations and warranties in this regard ; 
 
 In case the Purchased Unit requires any structural repairs or structural rectification, other than regular wear and tear, the Developer shall rectify or repair the same for a period of five (5) years from the Completion Date. 
 
 The Purchased Unit is subject to a builder’s defects liability warranty in respect of any defective material, fittings and fixtures including mechanical, plumbing and electrical works for a period of one (1) year from the date of completion of the construction thereof, except where such defects arise from an Event of Force Majeure or are caused or contributed to by the Buyer in the sole opinion of the Developer. 
 
 The Developer, through the building contractor, shall remain liable for a period of one (1) year from the Completion Date to repair or replace any inherently defective material, fittings and fixtures which shall include civil, mechanical, plumbing, and electrical works provided that the maintenance and/or replacement of all appliances in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers and the Developer shall have no liability thereof. 
 
 For avoidance of any doubt , it is clarified that the period of structural liability (Clause 7.3), defects liability warranty (Clause 7.4) and appliances and equipment warranties (Clause 7.5), shall commence with effect from the Completion Date. 
 
 The Developer will not be liable for any damage caused to the structure, fittings and fixtures where the damage is caused by normal wear and tear or where there is breakage or accidental damage caused or contributed to by any act or omission of the Buyer, occupant or visitor of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Developer shall construct or cause the construction of the infrastructure relating to the Project including roads, lighting, walkways, and landscaping substantively in accordance with its overall development plan for infrastructure of the Project ; 
 
 In the event that the Purchased Unit requires any structural repairs or structural rectification, the Developer or Hotel Management Company shal l rectify or repair the same , including regular wear and tear, during the Lease Period ; 
 The Developer covenants to take the Purchased Unit on lease from the Buyer against payment of Rent, and make timely Rent payments to the Buyer in accordance with the provisions of the Lease back Agreement ; 
 
 The Developer furth er covenants to issue Complimentary V ouchers to the Buyer , as per the terms of the Lease back Agreement . 
 
 BUYER’S COVENANTS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer covenants , undertakes or warrants as under: 
 
 The Purchased Unit is being purchased on the Buyer’s own behalf and the Buyer has the necessary legal capacity and authority to purchase the same ; 
 
 T o execute all documents and do and cause to be done all such acts as may be required by the Developer with respect to the leaseback and buyback of the Purchased Unit under this Agreement to Sell; 
 
 The Buyer shall , simultaneous to the execution of this Agreement to Sell, enter into the Lease back Agreement in favour of the Dev eloper or its nominee, to lease back and handover possession of the Purchased Unit to the Developer;

 H e/she shall not interfere in the Permitted Use of the Purchased Unit by the Developer or its nominee; 
 
 H e/she may utilize the C omplimentary V ouchers in accordance with the terms of the Lease back Agreement ; 
 
 U pon expiration of the L ease back A greement , the Buyer shall either renew the L ease back A greement as per the terms thereof, or execute a buy back agreement with the Developer in accordance with the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 The Buyer shall and shall procure that any Third Party shall: 
 
 Comply strictly with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the Leaseback Agreement , which shall prevail beyond the Completion Date; 
 
 Make the Purchased Unit a vailable exclusively for use by the Developer and/or the Hotel Management Company, their officers, employees, representative, agents , nominees, successors-in-interest and permitted assigns , at all times and without any hindrance and in accordance with the Lease back Agreement ; 
 
 Not enter or otherwise access the Purchased Unit other than in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Lease back Agreement; 
 
 Comply in all respects with the provisions of all laws, decrees, regulations and the Rules including the rules of and requirements of any Competent Authority in relation to the Purchased Unit or anything done in the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 Pay all taxes, charges , duties, and/ or levies that may be imposed or levied with respect to this Agreement , as per Clause 5. 
 
 Permit the Developer and/or the Hotel Management Company to make any partitions, alterations, additions, attachments of any nature in the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 Understand and acknowledge that the Buyer’s/Third Party’s obligations in this Agreement shall cont inue beyond the Completion Date . 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that t he Developer shall construct the infrastructure relating to the Project including inter alia boundary walls, roads, lighting, walkways and landscaping substantively in accordance with t he Developer ’s overall development plan for infrastructure and the Buyer shall have no objection to it. 
 
 The Buyer agrees not to modify, add or remove any part of the exterior and/or interior of the Purchased Unit or construct any additional improvements in the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that t he Developer shall endeavour and make all reasonable efforts to deliver the Purchased Unit as per the specifications in the Description of Purchased Unit . However, in the event of any modification, the Developer may substitute the Purchased Unit with another unit having similar specifications as the Purchased Unit. In the event the alternate Purchased Unit provided to the Buyer is of a lesser value the Buyer will be entitled to a refund of the difference between the Purchase Price of the original Purchased Unit and the substitute Unit without any mark- up or adjustment thereon , subject to the terms of this Agreement . 
 
 The Buyer confirms and declares that all the statements made and information provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct. In case any such statement or information is found to be incorrect or false , t he Developer shall have the right to cancel/terminate the allocation of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer by notice in writing, and any amount paid by the Buyer to t he Developer shall be forfeited in the manner and in terms of Clause 1 1 below . 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT BY THE BUYER 
 
 This Agreement shall not entitle , allow and or confer any right, easement or interest to the Buyer in the land, roof or Common Areas or Facilities of the Project and/or any other area not expressly forming part of the area of the Purchased Unit. The Buyer shall not have any right or claim in the Project other than the area of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 No sale, assignment, transfer or other disposition of an y interest in the Purchased Unit, whether before or after the Completion Date, will be binding on the Developer or of any legal effect until and unless : 
 
 Lease period (as defined in the L ease back A greement) has lapsed ; 
 
 t he Developer ’s prior written consent to such sale, assignment, transfer or other disposition of interest has been obtained by the Buyer; 
 
 the fees payable under Clause 9. 3 or otherwise howsoever have been paid in full to the satisfaction of t he Developer ; 
 
 all relevant taxes, duties , levies, and charges in relation to the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit have been paid ; 
 
 all payments due as at the effective date of the proposed transfer have been paid in full to the Developer and any Competent Authorities to its/ their satisfaction; and 
 
 the buyer/transferee/assignee to the Purchased Unit has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by this Agreement and the Leaseback Agreement, and has signed a letter of adherence or such other document in relation thereto as may be prescribed by t he Developer in this regard. 
 
 Any assignment, transfer or sale of the Purchased Unit by the Buyer shall be subject to payment of transfer charges of one percent ( 1 %) of the Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit, and any other applicable fees at the time, to the Developer . While allowing the assignment or sale, t he Developer shall have the right to impose additional terms and conditions. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, confirms and agrees that the sale price of the Purchased Unit, in the event of b uyback by the Developer upon lapse of the Lease back Agreement, shall be at a price equal to 1.7 times the total Purchase Price as specified in Description of Purchased Unit. 
 
 Developer may assign or otherwise transfer its rights and obligations under this Agreement or with respect to the Purchased Unit to any person or party by giving prior written notice to the Buyer and the Buyer hereby irrevocably and irreversibly grants the Developer the right of any such assignment or transfer. However, t he Developer shall make all reasonable effort to protect the interests of the Buyer unde r this Agreement . 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE DEVELOPER 
 
 Subject to the terms of this Agreement , in the event that the Developer or the Hotel Management Company is unable to launch the Purchased Unit as hotel apartment within six (6) months following the Estimated Completion Date, then, provided the Buyer has fulfilled all obligations and has made complete Instalment Payments in the Payment Plan, including the amount payable on possession and any applicable Adjusted Amount , the Developer shall pay the Buyer a monthly fee until such time as the Purchased Unit is launched as hotel apartment. The monthly fee shall be calculated on a pro-rata basis and shall be equal to five percent (5% ) per annum of the total payments received from the Buyer to date with respect to the Purchase Price . 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE BUYER AND DEFAULTING PENALTY 
 
 If the Buyer fails to pay any Instalment Payment or other payments due under this Agreement to the Developer or to any Competent Authority, within ten (10) days of its Due Date, then the Developer may: 
 
 impose liquidated damag es at the rate of two percent ( 2% ) per month on each outstanding Instalment Payment or any part thereof and /or any other payment ( s ) that remain (s) outstanding from the date such payment became due, to be paid in addition to such outstanding payments; and/or 
 
 in the event the default is not cured within sixty (60) days of the relevant Due Date, upon serving of first written notice of seven (7) days followed by final written notice of seven (7) days to the Buyer, terminate this Agreement forthwith and recover liquidated damages from the Buyer equivalent to fifteen percent ( 15% ) of the Purchase Price, in addition to the damages imposed under Clause 11 .1( i ) above. After deducting all charges under this Clause 11 .1 and any other charges that may be applicable from the Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer in accordance with the Payment Plan, the Developer shall refund the balance amount, if any, to the Buyer. In the event of any shortfall, the Developer shall be entitled to its rights under law to recover the same from the Buyer. 
 
 In the event that the Buyer fails to give any undertaking or execute any document of the Purchased Unit, then t he Developer may take the action specified under Clause 11 .1 (ii) above. 
 
 Delay in pa yment of any Instal ment Payment ( s ) or applicable Adjusted Amount exceeding sixty (60) days shall be treated as a default by the Buyer and t he Developer will be entitled to take action in accordance with Clause 11 .1(ii) above. 
 
 Joint Buyers shall, jointly and individually , be responsible to fulfil and discharge all the obligations hereinabove mentioned. Upon breach of any of the conditions of this Agreement by any one of them, t he Developer shall be at liberty for recourse and redressal in the terms of this Agreement against any one or all of the joint Buyers (as t he Developer may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means an act of God including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, windstorm or other natural disaster; act of any sovereign authority including but not limited to war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, nationalization, requisition, act of terrorism or destruction or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority or other Competent Authority or imposition of government sanction embargo or similar action; labour dispute including but not limited to strike, lockout or boycott; interruption or failure of utility service including but not limited to electric power, water or telephone service; failure of the transportation of any personnel, equipment, machinery or material required by t he Developer for completion of the Project; breach of contract by any essential contractor or subcontractor or any other matter or cause beyond the control of t he Developer that prevents it from completing or performing its obligations under this Agreement . The Developer shall not be liable for such non-completion or non-performance under this Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue. 
 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the Estimate d Completion Date or Completion Date, the Developer shall promptly notify the Buyer in writing of the event and give the Buyer a revised Estimated Completion or Completion Date or an estimate of the duration of the delay, as and when it can be determined. Extensions in the Estimated Completion or Completion Date on account of an Event of Force Majeure shall be in addition to any other extensions pursuant to the terms hereof . 
 
 No Event of Force Majeure which is less than thirty (30) calendar days shall excuse the Buyer from making any Instalment Payment on its Due Date, which may be extended for a period equal to the duration of the Event of Force Majeure. Provided that any Event of Force Majeure exceeding thirty (30) days shall result in a commensurate adjustment of the Due Date of any remaining Instalment Payments or any applicable Adjusted Amount . 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 This Agreement , as defined in Clause 2 of this Agreement to Sell, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and there are no other representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, whether made by t he Developer , any officer, agent, employee or representative of t he Developer or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, show room displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Buyer or made available for his/her viewing and , upon acceptance by t he Developer , this Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject only to the terms and conditions contained t herein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in this Agreement , any modification or amendment to this Agreement shall be in writing duly signed by both Parties . 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that he/ s he will be bound by the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 
 This Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to this Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan. 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to this Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act (X of 1940). After lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under this Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in this Agreement to Sell or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in case there is more than one Buyer, notice to any one Buyer shall be deemed as notice to all Buyers and t he Developer shall be under no obligation to write to each Buyer individually. 
 
 Buyer shall notify the Developer in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Buyer’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Developer to the Buyer at the last known address . 
 
 SURVIVAL 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that this Agreement will survive the Completion Date and transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer and any subsequent buyer . This Agreement shall en ure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assigns. 
 
 The Developer agrees that in case of the death of the Buyer , t he Developer shall make reasonable efforts to assist the Nominee named by the Buyer to procure the succession of the legal heirs to the rights of the Buyer under this Agreement , in accordance with the requirements of applicable law s of inheritance . Provided that the Nominee shall cause all such legal heirs to execute a letter of adherence (or such other document which confirms the legal heirs taking over and being fully bound by the obligations of the Buyer under this Agreement ) and indemnif y t he Developer for any loss or damage on account of claims by the other legal heirs of the Buyer . 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 This Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Agreement to Sell . 
 
 TIME IS OF ESSENCE 
 
 Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement , the time fixed for payment or any part thereof under this Agreement is and shall be the essence of this Agreement . 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 The delay or failure of either Party to enforce or insist upon strict compliance with any of the terms or conditions of this Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of said Party’s rights hereunder. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 If any one or more provisions of this Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 TERMINATION AND CANCELLATION OF SALE 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement , the Buyer may cancel or terminate this Agreement at any time, subject to deduction of cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent ( 15% ) of the Purchase Price and deduction on account of any other charge or cost payable by the Buyer under this Agreement . The balance of any payment made by the Buyer under this Agreement , if any, will be refunded to the Buyer within six (6 ) months of termination or upon re-sale of the cancelled Purchased Unit, whichever comes later. 
 
 Any refund upon termination under Clause 2 1 shall be subject to deduction of the difference between the Purchase Price and the market price of the Purchased Unit at the time of termination, in the event that the latter is lower. 
 
 In case of termination under Clause 2 1 , the Buyer shall surrender all original documents, acknowledgements of receipt and any other correspondence under this Agreement , including without limitation this Agreement itself. 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement , the Developer may cancel or terminate this Agreement in the event of breach of this Agreement by the Buyer as envisaged herein. Any refund to the Buyer as a result of termination under this Clause 21 .4 shall be subject to deduction of cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent ( 15% ) of the Purchase Price and deduction on account of any other charge or cost payable by the Buyer under this Agreement . 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perf orm their obligations under this Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 
 The Bu yer hereby confirms having read, understood , and accepted this Agreement in its entirety, and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
